description: ZuluGaz is Politerm’s gas-network hydraulic modelling package. It builds mathematical network representations and supports pressure, diameter, reserve-capacity, switching and gas-emission calculations. The provider is Politerm. Coverage: Models cover user-defined low-, medium- and high-pressure gas networks supplied by one or more stations. Gas-mixture parameters are supplied by the user; no shared observation period applies. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Provider feature descriptions do not establish numerical accuracy for a particular network. Licence, integration and current pricing require provider confirmation. For simulation it supports gas-distribution design and operational scenario analysis. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
